The best team players were Gianna and Kym. At the beginning of the shift while Gianna was there, she was absolutely carrying on walk bar and killing it going so fast. Kym also was doing a bunch of things at once when it was super busy which helped a lot. Landen could have worn More H. on shift. I had put him as R2/window since we were so busy but didn’t have enough people to have a consistent runner 2. I would have expected him to hop outside when the line gets busy and hop on window when needed. Instead he did a ton of GSD stuff which was nice but not helpful because he was restocking things that weren’t a priority at all and I had to ask him to go outside multiple times or I ended up having to run or be stuck on window instead of Xbro-ing like we needed. The IPads not working is a REALLY major issue. Every single shift they are dead or not working and today was really bad. The walk up card reader and IPAD were dead the entire shift and wouldn’t charge, so we were having to walk over from walk up and charge people out at DT which took up a lot of time. Even when plugged in to the back, it didn’t charge them because they are just broken and won’t charge. The DT iPad also died, as well as almost all of the runners IPADS. None of them will charge and if they do, it will charge to like 20% in 3 hours and then die within 5 minutes. We weren’t even able to have a runner 2 for the shift because there wasn’t only one working IPAD. Even the iPads that were charged wouldn’t connect to the readers or wouldn’t connect to the WiFi after every 3 cars. Overall the iPads are just a huge issue and definitely slowed us down a ton today.
